motions.item_title: Approve the minutes. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the minutes. Commissioner Hess seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Commission minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of an earlier meeting; the record does not say which one.
motions.impact: This makes the commission's written record official. You will not notice it.

motions.item_title: Forward a positive recommendation to the Council of Item 7. A. Temporary Site Plan - Sweetwater…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to forward a positive recommendation to the Council of Item 7. A. Temporary Site Plan - Sweetwater Stake Center for a period of 18 months. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Temporary site plan for Sweetwater Stake Center
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve an 18-month temporary site plan for the Sweetwater Stake Center.
motions.impact: Nothing takes effect yet: the council makes the final call. The motion does not say what the temporary plan covers, so whatever changes it brings would last 18 months at that one site.
